description.value: La Gondola is a family-owned Italian and Canadian restaurant that has anchored Prince Rupert's dining scene since 1952. It occupies a Venetian-style building overlooking Prince Rupert Harbour, offering dine-in with harbour-view window seats alongside a nostalgic old-fashioned drive-in with curbside car service. The menu ranges from homemade burgers and milkshakes to Northern Italian classics like veal scallopini a la Marsala and baked lasagna Bolognese, with a licensed dining room rounding out the experience.
